source.title: Panchgani ka hidden waterfall spot
source.description:
पंचगनी का एक ऐसा खूबसूरत और शांत वॉटरफॉल, जिसके बारे में शायद ही आपको पता हो। प्रकृति के बीच सुकून का अनुभव करें।

आज हम आपको पंचगनी की एक ऐसी जगह पर ले जा रहे हैं जो शहर की भीड़भाड़ से दूर है। यह पंचगनी वॉटरफॉल अपनी शांति और सुंदर नज़ारों के लिए जाना जाता है, जहाँ पहाड़ और हरियाली आपका मन मोह लेंगे। अगर आप भी किसी शांत जगह की तलाश में हैं, तो यह वीडियो आपको ज़रूर देखना चाहिए।

यह जगह उन लोगों के लिए बेहतरीन है जो अपने दोस्तों या परिवार के साथ एक शांत वीकेंड गेटवे की योजना बना रहे हैं। पंचगनी टूरिस्ट प्लेस की लिस्ट में यह एक ऐसी जगह है जो आपको प्रकृति के करीब ले जाएगी और आपको एक यादगार अनुभव देगी।

चैनल को सब्सक्राइब करें ताकि आप ऐसी और भी यात्राओं का आनंद ले सकें, और कमेंट में बताएं कि आपको यह नज़ारा कैसा लगा?

pack.topic: Evaluating Land Elevation and Monsoon Water Runoff in Coimbatore Properties
pack.source_script_insight: In the source clip, the subject transitions from a close-up pose to an ultra-wide angle view to reveal the full valley and waterfall below. In real estate due diligence, looking only at the immediate flat plot boundary (1x) hides low-lying topographical traps; expanding to an ultra-wide spatial inspection reveals natural drainage paths and slope risks during heavy monsoon rains.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Coimbatore's Western Ghats foothill pockets (Vadavalli, Thondamuthur, Kovai Pudur, Kovaipudur slope belts) experience intense monsoon runoff. Buyers often inspect dry plots in summer without evaluating surrounding terrain contour, leading to unexpected waterlogging when mountain rain streams downhill.
pack.visual_strategy: The visuals strictly focus on physical topographical evidence: digital slope inclinometers, red-soil gradient cuts, rainwater channels along Western Ghats foothills, contour map overlays on mobile phones, and concrete side-drain capacity checks. Camera movements use rapid tilt-ups, micro-level measurements, and grounded high-angle terrain observations—strictly avoiding generic family or housing montage default storylines.
pack.core_takeaway: Never buy land based on a flat front view alone; inspect the wider elevation contours and seasonal water drainage paths from multiple angles.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
A. MANDATORY OUTPUT FORMAT LOCK
- Exact Duration: 10.0 seconds
- Native Aspect Ratio: Vertical 9:16 portrait format.
- Resolution: 4K crisp photorealistic real-world video footage.
- Target Audience: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

B. REALISM LOCK
- Ultra-photorealistic 4K real-world video shot on professional handheld/cinematic camera.
- Authentic Coimbatore environment: rich red loam soil, lush Western Ghats monsoon foliage in background, natural overcast cloudy sunlight, natural dust particles, realistic textures, soft atmospheric mist over distant hills.
- ABSOLUTELY NO 3D renders, CGI, architectural walkthroughs, stock graphic animations, floating icons, or cartoon elements.

C. SOURCE SUBJECT LOCK
- Core Educational Topic: Topography & Natural Drainage Due Diligence for Land Buyers.
- Source Evidence Points Applied:
  1. Broadening perspective from tight close-up to wide-angle reveals critical terrain drops.
  2. Checking low-lying zones and digital slope incline detects hidden water accumulation.
  3. Evaluating seasonal rain runoff paths prevents monsoon flooding mistakes.
  4. Multi-angle inspection of surrounding elevation relative to drains ensures site safety.

D. SUBJECT-SPECIFIC VISUAL STRATEGY
- Focus strictly on physical evidence: granite survey stones, red soil slope gradients, digital spirit level instruments, topographic mobile elevation maps, concrete roadside drainage channels, and leveling rods.
- FORBIDDEN DEFAULT STORYLINE: Do NOT show empty plot turning into a house, family entering a house, construction workers, or generic promotional banners.

E. CAMERA + IMAGE QUALITY
- 4K optical clarity, natural color grading matching monsoon light in Western Tamil Nadu.
- Realistic optical depth of field, natural motion blur on fast camera tilts, zero geometry distortion.

F. EXACT 7-SHOT PLAN (10 SECONDS TOTAL)

Scene 1 (0.0s - 1.4s):
- Location: Red soil plot boundary in Vadavalli, Coimbatore.
- Visual: Extreme close-up of a weathered granite survey stone sticking out of dark red soil. Camera rapidly tilts upward, revealing a steep downward slope leading toward a distant valley framed by Western Ghats clouds.
- On-Screen Text: "முழு பார்வை"
- Voiceover Tamil: "இடத்தை மனையில் இருந்து மட்டும் பார்க்காதீங்க,"

Scene 2 (1.4s - 2.8s):
- Location: Sloped earthen boundary.
- Visual: Micro ground-level shot of a yellow digital spirit level resting on raw red soil showing a numerical display indicating a downward slope gradient.
- On-Screen Text: "பள்ளத்தாக்கு ஆபத்து"
- Voiceover Tamil: "சுற்றிலும் உள்ள சரிவு,"

Scene 3 (2.8s - 4.2s):
- Location: Foothill plot edge near Marudhamalai road.
- Visual: High-angle static downward view of small natural rainwater channels cut into the red earth showing clear erosion lines from monsoon runoff.
- On-Screen Text: "மழைநீர் பாதை"
- Voiceover Tamil: "மழைநீர் செல்லும் பாதையை,"

Scene 4 (4.2s - 5.6s):
- Location: Open site in Kovai Pudur.
- Visual: Over-the-shoulder shot of hands holding a smartphone displaying a detailed topographic contour map with blue drainage lines, with the actual red land visible in soft focus background.
- On-Screen Text: "வரைபட சரிபார்ப்பு"
- Voiceover Tamil: "வெவ்வேறு கோணத்தில்,"

Scene 5 (5.6s - 7.0s):
- Location: Suburban road layout in Coimbatore.
- Visual: Low-angle smooth pan across a deep, wide concrete storm drainage channel along a paved bitumen street, showing high volumetric capacity.
- On-Screen Text: "வடிகால் அளவு"
- Voiceover Tamil: "ஆராய்ந்து சரிபாருங்கள்."

Scene 6 (7.0s - 8.5s):
- Location: Upper elevation plot boundary.
- Visual: Eye-level shot of a surveyor's hand positioning an aluminum leveling rod onto a high concrete kerb stone, checking site elevation relative to road level.
- On-Screen Text: "உயரம் சரிபார்ப்பு"
- Voiceover Tamil: "சரியான மேடான நிலத்தை"

Scene 7 (8.5s - 10.0s):
- Location: Well-developed high ground in Western Coimbatore.
- Visual: Wide static high-angle view of a well-graded, perfectly dry elevated residential plot featuring proper side concrete drainage gutters, framed against distant mountain mist.
- On-Screen Text: "OliveTree Investors"
- Voiceover Tamil: "தேர்ந்தெடுங்கள்!"

G. MOTION-GRAPHICS LIMIT
- Only small, crisp white Tamil text overlays positioned in lower third. No full-screen banners or animated transitions.

H. FINAL REAL SCENE
- Ends on real-world photo-realistic elevated plot with clear concrete drainage. Minimal branding "OliveTree Investors" overlaid at bottom center.

I. NEGATIVE PROMPT / FIXED RULES
- NO cartoons, NO 3D architectural renders, NO graphic animations, NO house construction montages, NO generic happy families, NO text distortion, NO black bars, NO 16:9 landscape video cropped in portrait, NO fake landmarks, NO unrealistic camera morphs.
pack.title_english: Coimbatore Land Incline & Water Drainage Check
pack.caption_english: Before finalizing plot purchases in Coimbatore's foothill belts like Vadavalli or Kovaipudur, never rely on a single flat viewpoint. A plot that appears dry in summer may sit in a natural monsoon runoff path. Always expand your view to evaluate slope contours, water flow directions, and drainage infrastructure capacity from multiple angles. Conduct thorough topographical due diligence with OliveTree Investors to secure safely elevated properties.
